yields.name: Generator Accelerator
yields.why: Generator Accelerator (read: 1.21.1-1.6.2) @Overwrites NoiseChunk$FlatCache.compute at the default priority with its own flat array. Mixin refuses our @WrapOperation into a method another mixin overwrote at equal priority (the class would fail to load and the game would stop at the first world load), and the table this switch keeps stands around vanilla's one noiseFiller.compute call, so this switch steps aside whenever that mixin is listed. Found by a scan of the other mods' mixins on the same classes for the 1.21.1 port of 1.0.50 (287 jars, bytecode read, not run in game).
